descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92579 AC 2, AC 7, AC 8 · “On delete, a confirmation message (same app-style UI) says "[Name]'s patient card was deleted"”. Mixed: stated part — OK removes that card, the toast names it, the patient's data is gone; our part — look-alike neighbour surviving, the old chart URL showing 'not found' (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B24 · S1 · known

Delete: Hospital uses the browser's native confirm and shows no 'deleted' toast; Nursing Home residents cannot be deleted at all

Tickets: TFA-92579 AC 7–8 ready for qa; TFA-94514 AC 1 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579): no 'deleted' toast is AC 8; TC-24/S03 fails on the same evidence; Nursing Home has no trash icon and no screen calls snf.remove (TC-24/S05, dev U09).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S16, OAT-06/S22, TC-24/S03, TC-24/S05, TC-24/S28

Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S17 Cancel vs OK × Hospital vs Nursing Home on a look-alike list: OK removes exactly that card, the toast names it, its chart URL is dead, the neighbour survives

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T6 On delete, a confirmation message in the same app-style UI says "[Name]'s patient card was deleted". (TFA-92579 AC 8)
  • T5 A patient card can be removed by tapping its trash icon; a pop-up designed like the app UI tells the user what happens if they delete, and the user presses Cancel or OK. (TFA-92579 AC 7)
  • T2 Deleting a patient removes all of that patient's data immediately (hard delete, not hidden); the audit log of who accessed the chart is kept. (TFA-92579 AC 2; UAT TC-24)
  • U8 With multiple patients loaded, everything above holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-01; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given seededCensus look-alikes: H1 Ana Rivera and H2 Ben Rivera; N1 Dora Nguyen and N2 Hoa Nguyen. The agent notes the deleted patient's chart URL before deleting

When Nursing Home first: trash on Hoa's card → OK, snapshot at once; open Hoa's noted chart URL; open Dora's chart. Then Hospital: trash on Ben's card → OK, snapshot; open Ben's URL; open Ana's chart

Then Only the tapped card is gone; the in-app toast reads "<deleted name>'s patient card was deleted"; the old chart URL shows 'not found' and none of the deleted patient's data; the neighbour's card and chart (room, diagnosis) are intact

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Table: Cancel → card stays, no toast (S16); OK → that card gone + toast naming it + 'not found' at its URL + neighbour intact. oracle.mjs: after-OK mustContain 'Open chart for <neighbour>' and the one string "<deleted>'s patient card was deleted", mustNotContain 'Open chart for <deleted>', "<neighbour>'s patient card was deleted" and 'native dialog:'; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92579 ready for qa

After a Hospital delete is confirmed, no "<Name>'s patient card was deleted" message appears; the confirm is the browser's own box, and Nursing Home cards cannot be deleted at all.

Evidence: datasets lane (identity dataset). The native confirm and the missing NH trash icon are dev report §2 #7 / U09. The missing toast (AC 8) is not called out in §2, but ledger U09 says ACs 2/4/7/8 have no PR, and matrix Q8 expects them to fail. The exact toast wording is Q7.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
